subject: ddl: fix dynamic parameter adjustment failure in txn and local ingest mode (#63605)
summary: Moves dynamic reorg parameter refresh (thread/batch_size/max_write_speed) to the executing reorg paths by adding `reorgInfo.UpdateConfigFromSysTbl` (reads latest job from `mysql.tidb_ddl_job`) and invoking it in txn backfill and local ingest tuning loops; removes the previous job-worker poll loop’s in-memory ReorgMeta sync and adds failpoints/tests to validate `ADMIN ALTER DDL JOBS` takes effect in these modes.
